title: Beehive Audit & Consulting for farms — by the Bee Lady
price: R 7 500 per audit + transport & accommodation outside the George area
description:
[photos:/static/super/ml/bee_538_02.jpg|/static/super/bee_8_audit.jpg|/static/super/ml/bee_538_03.jpg|/static/super/ml/bee_538_04.jpg|/static/super/ml/bee_538_05.jpg|/static/super/ml/bee_538_06.jpg|/static/super/ml/bee_538_07.jpg|/static/super/ml/bee_538_08.jpg|/static/super/ml/bee_538_09.jpg|/static/super/ml/bee_538_10.jpg|/static/super/ml/bee_538_11.jpg|/static/super/ml/bee_538_12.jpg|/static/super/ml/bee_538_13.jpg|/static/super/ml/bee_538_14.jpg|/static/super/ml/bee_538_15.jpg]
**Experience:** 11 yrs

BEE Healthy... BEE Productive... BEE Sure. I come to your farm, inspect your hives and audit what you have: the number and condition of the hives, colony strength, brood and queens, pests and disease (Varroa mite, Nosema, American Foulbrood), equipment, siting and forage — including hives kept for pollination.

You receive a written report with a clear plan to bring every hive to a healthy status: what to repair or replace, what to treat, and in which order. Through my network in South African beekeeping I can bring in the right specialists and equipment suppliers for whatever your hives need, and their details go into your report. The aim is simple: a healthy, thriving bee environment on your farm.

11 years of hands-on beekeeping (self-employed since 2015), keeping and breeding my own bees. Secretary of the Northerns Beekeepers Association since 2016, member of SABIO and registered with DALRRD (2025 certificate). Trained in beginner and advanced beekeeping, bee removal and queen rearing.

R 7 500 per audit and report; outside the George area, transport and accommodation are added. Based in Great Brak River, between George and Mossel Bay — contact me with your farm location and number of hives.

Situated in a secure, access-controlled complex in Rietvalleirand, this 182 m² simplex has plenty of space and everything already set up for comfortable, everyday living. Walking through the front door, the extra height in the ceilings immediately gives the open-plan lounge and dining area a bright, open feel with lots of natural light. The kitchen is fitted with Caesarstone tops, quality Smeg appliances, a prep bowl, and plenty of cupboard space, plus a separate scullery that easily fits three appliances and a double fridge. The complex properties is truly the best choice, having additional scullery space. This is a property not to be missed!

There are three generously-sized bedrooms with large built-in cupboards. The main bedroom has a full en-suite bathroom (both bath and shower), and the second bathroom is also a full bathroom, so there’s never a fight for space in the morning.

Sliding doors open out to a covered patio with a built-in braai, looking onto a big wraparound garden with plenty of lawn for the kids and pets. Weekly lawn mowing is already covered by the complex, keeping upkeep simple.

The property is tiled throughout, and all windows feature aluminum frames. Additionally, there are play-areas for kids inside the complex.

A huge bonus is the off-grid setup: you get a full 8 kVA solar system with an inverter and two backup batteries, as well as a 2,220-litre backup water tank with a filtration system (which goes beyond the standard set-up and makes live abundantly easier). A double automated garage gives you direct, secure parking into the home. It’s also ideally located for quick access to the R21 and N1 highways, close to schools like Hoërskool Waterkloof and Laerskool Elarduspark, and just down the road from Castle Gate, Irene Mall, Wolwespruit Hiking & Biking Trails, and much more!

Viewings strictly by appointment only. Enquire, or WhatsApp message to book your viewing.

BEE Wise... BEE Trained... BEE a Beekeeper. A hands-on beekeeping course taught by a working beekeeper — not a theory lecture, but the real craft, learned at the hive in full protective gear.

11 years of hands-on beekeeping (self-employed since 2015), keeping and breeding my own bees. Secretary of the Northerns Beekeepers Association since 2016, member of SABIO and registered with DALRRD (2025 certificate). Trained in beginner and advanced beekeeping, bee removal and queen rearing.

Run on demand and tailored to your group — beginners, farmers, schools, clubs or private groups. Content is set to your needs, from the basics: how a hive works, protective gear and safe handling, hive inspections, seasonal hive management, bee health and disease control (Varroa mite, Nosema, American Foulbrood), responsible harvesting of honey, wax and propolis, and starting your own first hive.

Based in Great Brak River, between George and Mossel Bay. Contact me with your group size and goals and I will put the course together for you, at my apiary or your venue.

BEE Curious... BEE Amazed... Book a Bee Talk. A lively, down-to-earth talk about bees for your venue — schools, garden clubs, lodges and guest farms, retirement villages, farmers' groups, church groups or corporate teams.

11 years of hands-on beekeeping (self-employed since 2015), keeping and breeding my own bees. Secretary of the Northerns Beekeepers Association since 2016, member of SABIO and registered with DALRRD (2025 certificate). Trained in beginner and advanced beekeeping, bee removal and queen rearing.

Topics, tailored to your audience: the secret life of the hive and how a colony works, why bees matter for our food, honey, propolis and beeswax from hive to jar, what to do (and NOT do) when a swarm arrives, and why a bee removal is skilled, paid work for a trained beekeeper. Posters, real hive tools and product samples come along for show-and-tell. Talks run 45–60 minutes with question time.

Based in Great Brak River, between George and Mossel Bay. Book ahead and I will schedule your talk, or contact me to arrange a date at your venue.

title: Krugerrand proof collection — 28 coins, authenticated
description:
[photos:/static/super/sup_collect_1_main.jpg|/static/super/sup_collect_2_coin.jpg|/static/super/sup_collect_3_case.jpg]
Twenty-eight one-ounce proof Krugerrands in a fitted walnut presentation case, spanning decades of mintings and including sought-after duplicate-year proof strikings. Each coin authenticated with SAGCE certificates and stored in climate control since acquisition. A once-in-a-generation numismatic offering with full provenance documentation.
